cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
산 넘고 물 건너
언더시티 앞 언덕에
원정대 야영 끝!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle three-quarter shot of Night Elf Priest standing cheerfully on the left with her hands on her hips and her staff neatly stowed on her back, beside a warm beige-and-brown quilted medieval adventurer wool sleeping bag with leather straps on a minimal grass patch. To the right in the background, two tiny chibi Alliance paladin extras rest near a miniature distant green Undercity spire prop.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
브릴 정화 완료!
어, 이단 언데드 성기사다!
기사님들, 심판 날려요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder dynamic angle from behind Night Elf Priest on the left, who has her staff stowed on her back and points excitedly forward across a minimal dark cobblestone street patch. On the right, Undead Paladin stands holding a one-handed mace and a golden paladin shield with a mildly annoyed deadpan expression, while a tiny knocked-out Horde villager prop lies comedically flat nearby.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
이단도 깔끔히 눕혔으니
이제 로데론 성까지
평화롭게 정화 행진!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Side-profile marching shot of Night Elf Priest on the right happily holding her golden Holy Cross and Sunburst Cleric staff upright as she leads two tiny chibi Alliance paladin extras toward a minimal ruined Lordaeron stone archway on the ground. Far behind her on the left edge, an ominous tiny dust cloud rises.

Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dramatic low-angle wide confrontation shot: on the right, Night Elf Priest clutches her staff, frozen pale with wide shocked eyes and comic sweatdrops. On the left, Undead Paladin stands tall with a cold deadpan glare, holding her one-handed mace and golden paladin shield atop a glowing golden Consecration rune patch, backed by an overwhelming crowd of angry Horde Undead Paladin and Orc Warrior silhouettes.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
아까부터 이단 거리더니.
여긴 우리 앞마당인데
누가 누굴 정화해.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic close-up action shot as Undead Paladin on the left slams her golden paladin shield forward and swings her one-handed mace, triggering bright golden Consecration runes across a minimal stone floor patch. On the right, Night Elf Priest tumbles backward off her feet with dizzy spiral eyes and her staff slipping midair.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
원정대 정화 완료.
영혼의 치유사는
저쪽 무덤에 있다.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Quiet three-quarter wide shot: on the left, Night Elf Priest floats weakly as a translucent pale-blue spirit ghost with her staff faded on her back beside a minimal weathered gravestone and a cute non-gore skull prop. On the right, Undead Paladin stands calmly with her mace stowed at her waist and golden paladin shield on her back, pointing her thumb casually toward the graveyard with a deadpan face.
